metadata.currency: Text contains those laws in effect on April 8, 2026

children.label: (a)
children.heading: Failure to register or reregister
children.text: Every person who is required to register or reregister under section 4101 and fails to do so shall pay a penalty in addition to the tax (if any).

children.label: (b)
children.heading: Amount of penalty
children.text: The amount of the penalty under subsection (a) shall be- (1) $10,000 for each initial failure to register or reregister, and (2) $1,000 for each day thereafter such person fails to register or reregister.

children.label: (c)
children.heading: Reasonable cause exception
children.text: No penalty shall be imposed under this section with respect to any failure if it is shown that such failure is due to reasonable cause.

entries: Pub. L. 109–59, §11164(b)(1)(C), inserted "or reregister" after "register" in section catchline. Subsecs. (a), (b). Pub. L. 109–59, §11164(b)(1)(A), (B), inserted "or reregister" after "register" wherever appearing.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2005 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 109–59 applicable to actions, or failures to act, after Aug. 10, 2005, see section 11164(c) of Pub. L. 109–59, set out as a note under section 4101 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.effective_date: apply to penalties imposed after December 31, 2004.
notes.text: Pub. L. 108–357, title VIII, §863(e), Oct. 22, 2004, 118 Stat. 1620 , provided that: "The amendments made by this section [enacting this section and section 6725 of this title and amending sections 7232 and 7272 of this title] shall apply to penalties imposed after December 31, 2004."
